messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — spike in 5xx + 429s observed
incident-bot: Summary: api-gateway (us-west-2) showing rising 5xx rate from 00:10 -> 00:19, concurrent 429s on rate-limiter service RL-EDGE. Impact: increased latency and client retries causing gateway timeouts. Pager sent to #eng-oncall and #eng-sre.

maya: oncall here. getting paged, joining. seen similar pattern in last deploy? :thinking_face:

lucas: i'm on it. looking at rl-edge logs and gateway errors. initial glance: a config push to rl-config-service rolled out a tighter per-tenant token policy at 00:08 — might be mis-applied to internal infra tenants.

anna: noticing high queue backlog on inference-proxy pods behind gateway -> pods returning 502 after timeout. also KV cache evictions spiking.

tate: support reporting 3 enterprise customers seeing 5xx on embeddings endpoint; they call it "batch failure". customers: acme-corp, kald, prism-ads.

sylvie: flagged to CS and AMs. need ETA for mitigation — customers are in production.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop RL config rollout (rollback) 2) bump temporary global quota 3) enable fallback routing to us-east-1 for critical tenants 4) throttle internal flooders. lucas please execute step 1.

lucas: rolling back RL-EDGE config now.

deploy-bot: rollback started for rl-config-service deployment rl-config-2026-03-15T00:07 -> initiating canary rollback.

episode-log: ```
rl-config-service: rollback request accepted
k8s rollout status rl-config-service: rolling back to rl-config-2026-03-09 (rev 42)
``` 

lucas: rollback complete, canary stable. but we're still seeing residual 429 bursts from edge cache nodes — looks like token bucket counters didn't reset.

anna: yep, gateway still spiking 502s. here's a snippet from gateway logs:

```
2026-03-15T00:14:32Z gateway us-west-2 svc:proxy (req_id=abc123) upstream_timeout after 30s -> 502
2026-03-15T00:14:33Z rl-edge (node=rl-10) token_deduct failed tenant=acme-corp allowed=0 remaining=0
2026-03-15T00:14:34Z proxy queued reqs=120 inflight=98
```

maya: lucas — can we force-reset RL counters for affected nodes? if not, plan B: temporarily disable RL for affected tenant IDs.

lucas: forcing reset now via admin endpoint on rl-edge nodes.

lucas: admin reset returned success for rl-10, rl-11, rl-12. counters show refill.

maya: good. anna, any change on gateway metrics?

anna: latency dropping slowly. 502s reduced from 18/min -> 6/min. but still seeing cascading retries from clients triggering downstream overload. I'm going to open an emergency circuit-breaker on inference-proxy to reject heavy batched calls above 4 concurrent streams per IP.

anna: applying traffic-class override: `kubectl patch svc inference-proxy -p '{"spec": {"annotations": {"rbac.redwood/traffic-class": "recovery"}}}'`

deploy-bot: patch accepted, pods rolling with new env OVERRIDE_TRAFFIC_CLASS=recovery.

maya: great. sylvie — please coordinate customer comms: notify affected tenants we're mitigating with potential brief degradation and rollback applied.

sylvie: drafting now. message: "We observed transient elevated errors impacting some generation and embeddings calls in us-west-2. Our engineers rolled back a rate-limit config and applied temporary traffic controls. Expect intermittent retries for next ~30m. We'll update as we stabilize." Sending to acme-corp and kald.

tate: customers acknowledged; acme reports partial recovery for their test jobs.

lucas: one more piece — RL config change had an unintended mapping where infra-service accounts were included in same bucket as external tenants. root cause: a missing selector in the deployment template. filing PR to add explicit tenantLabel filter.

maya: create an incident ticket and link PR. include postmortem owner.

lucas: ticket created: INC-2026-03-15-rl-misroute. PR: github.com/redwood/rl-config/pull/892

maya: follow-up actions (post incident):
- add safe-guard checks to rl-config pipeline (validate tenant selectors)  
- make counter-reset an automated rollback step  
- add synthetic checks for tenant-specific quotas in staging  
- update runbook to include fallback to us-east routing

sylvie: will own customer follow-up + cs postmortem note.

anna: metrics look stable now; error rate back to baseline ~0.4% across gateways. will keep elevated monitoring for 1h.

lucas: preparing hotfix patch for selector bug, will merge after tests. timeline ~2h.

maya: closing pager for now. if error rate crosses threshold again, re-escalate. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — rollback complete, mitigation actions applied, monitoring ongoing. ticket: INC-2026-03-15-rl-misroute
